up: Retrieve exact IC50 values in nM for compounds targeting Renin (CHEMBL286). Return: compound ChEMBL IDs, canonical SMILES, PubMed IDs or DOIs (prefer PubMed, fallback to DOI), assay description, and target details. Join activities (filter for exact IC50 values in nM), compound_structures, docs, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL286', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM', activities.standard_relation = '='. Do not limit rows.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS smiles, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.pref_name AS target_details, a.standard_value AS ic50_nM FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL286' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
